answer: Each task is instantiated only after a specified future drand quicknet pulse, mixing its verified threshold-BLS output with the task ID and a previously committed participant nonce to derive an unpredictable challenge. The echo, fable, and sable fields are domain-separated inputs, not reusable answers; a short response window and public verification make advance computation and offline farming across many Sybil identities ineffective, while the beacon prevents any single requester from choosing the challenge.
